name: studio-sd
description: Tienda Studio SD: backend Django + frontend React. Comandos para automatizar el trabajo.

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm install --prefix tienda_frontend && node scripts/python.mjs -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev:https: concurrently --kill-others -n django,react -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:backend:https" "npm run dev:https --prefix tienda_frontend"
scripts.dev:backend:https: node scripts/python.mjs DJANGO_USAR_HTTPS=True manage.py runserver_plus --cert-file certs/cert.pem --key-file certs/key.pem 8443
scripts.revisar: node scripts/python.mjs manage.py check && npm run lint --prefix tienda_frontend
scripts.auditar: node scripts/python.mjs -m pip_audit -r requirements.txt && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix tienda_frontend
scripts.pruebas: node scripts/python.mjs manage.py test cuentas pedidos catalogo
scripts.preview: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others -n django,react -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:backend" "npm run preview --prefix tienda_frontend"
scripts.exportar-catalogo: node scripts/python.mjs -X utf8 manage.py dumpdata catalogo --indent 2 -o catalogo/fixtures/catalogo_inicial.json
